blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with a cohesive single-accent palette (#4477AA), clear typographic hierarchy (uppercase panel labels, muted axis text, bright title), and a well-proportioned multi-panel grid layout — held back from 8 by a dense, hard-to-read force graph where node labels are illegible at rendered size.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: All circle/node encodings correctly use scaleSqrt, bar chart has zero baseline with data-driven domain, monthly bin thresholds are data-driven, no dual axes or silent gaps — minor robustness note that the timeline Y scale is fixed to full-dataset max during cross-filter, but this is intentional context-preserving dashboard design.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing is correctly implemented for all brush/click events; no transitions means no mid-flight snap risk; pointer events avoid mouse-touch fights; however, all scales (x in timeline, x/y in color view) are captured in static closures with no ResizeObserver or window resize handler, so resizing the viewport will misalign brush coordinates and canvas hit-testing.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Five fully-linked views (timeline brush, force network with up to 60 nodes, color scatter, list, thumbnails) update in lockstep — the network is visibly dense and spaghetti-prone at that node count, the color scatter is a mass of undifferentiated dots, and the thumbnail wall adds a separate visual task, collectively pushing well past working-memory limits for coordinated cross-filtering.
